sections.html: The Store Map is our live floor plan and the home base for shop work: where every piano is, what phase it's in, your work clock, photos, paperwork, and requests. Everything you do in it is logged under your name —

sections.title: 1 Signing in and out
sections.html:
• Sign in with Google using your .blp@gmail.com account (preferred — one tap after the first time), Sign out: tap your own name in the top bar (it has a small ⏻ mark). On shared devices, always sign out so the next person's work is logged as theirs.
  • If "sign-in expired," just retry — the app renews your session by itself in about 2 seconds.

sections.title: 2 Finding a piano
sections.html:
• Search bar: type a serial, make, model, or year — suggestions appear as you type; keep typing to narrow. Pick one to jump to it on the map.
  • Scan the shop tag: point your phone camera at the QR on any piano's printed tag — the app opens that exact piano's card. Fastest way on the floor.
  • Floors: First / Second floor buttons top-left. Pinching zooms the map; the header never scrolls away.

sections.title: 3 Reading the map icons
sections.html:
• Red slash over a wrench (🔧⃠): PRE-QUEUE — the deposit hasn't been received. No work may start on this piano. Only a manager can release it.
  • Gold ✓ / gold ring: sold or completed but still in the building — awaiting delivery.
  • Dashed gold "TEMP" box: a temporary parking spot a manager created — treat it like any spot; it disappears when the piano moves on.
  • Camera badge: media is needed on that piano.

sections.title: 4 The piano card (tap any piano)
sections.html:
Sections are the red banners — tap a banner to collapse or expand it; the app remembers your preferences.

  • 📍 Locations: move a piano by typing the new spot — only real spots are accepted; pick from the suggestion list (includes areas like Attic, Sanding Shop). 🕘 Location history shows everywhere it's been, and who moved it.
  • 🔨 Shop Progress: track, keys, phase dropdown, Done checkmarks, and tasks. Update the phase the moment you finish — stale phases scramble the whole shop's scheduling.
  • ⏱ Work Clock — the big new habit:
  • Clock in when you start working on a piano; clock out when you stop. This is how job costing and your hours work now.
  • You must pick the phase first (or choose "✏️ Other" and write a few words). The green button won't fire without it.
  • One piano at a time: clocking into a new piano automatically closes your previous session — switching is one tap, no math.
  • While clocked in you'll see a green timer chip in the top bar and a dock at the bottom — Switch and Clock out live there.
  • Quiet for 15 minutes? The dock asks if you're still on it — answer honestly; "clock out at last activity" backdates correctly.
  • Scanning a piano's tag highlights the Work Clock so scan → clock in is two taps.
  • 📷 Media: "Add before photos" / "Add after photos" file pictures straight into the piano's Drive folders, sized for the web. Use them — the daily report tracks what's missing.
  • 📁 Paperwork: QC checklist scans (the app can find them by serial) plus slots for bass string orders, tear-down sheets, plating orders.
  • 📖 Piano Log: everything else from the sheet, and a link to the exact row.
  • 📨 Request… menu: moves, tunings, service, Curtis Harper, admin requests, Brigham tasks — routed to the right person automatically.

sections.title: 5 💡 Suggest improvements (please do!)
sections.html:
• Tap the 💡 bulb in the top bar → pick ✏️ Edit or 💡 Idea → one or two sentences → attach a screenshot if it helps → Send it 🚀.
  • Watch "My requests" in that same panel: when yours flips to LIVE, you'll get a text — go try it and tap "✅ It works." Contributors get named in the daily briefing.

sections.title: 6 Texting the shop number
sections.html: You can text changes to the shop's number, in plain words: "38930 phase DHRT" · "moved 29908 to 83a" · "here's a photo of 55383" (photos attach to the piano). Same rules apply — it's logged as you.

sections.title: 7 Reports & the archive (☰ menu)
sections.html:
• Reports: unplaced pianos, duplicates, media needed, and the Activity log with filters — by person, action, piano, time window. Every view has a ✕ (or press Escape) to get back to the map.
  • 📦 Delivered Archive: delivered pianos leave the map but live here — searchable, cards intact.

sections.title: 8 Managers & admins only
sections.html:
• Pre-Queue approval: the yellow-banner pianos can only be released into the queue by admins or Mark — confirming the $1,000 deposit is in.
  • 📍 Temp map spot (Request menu): tap open floor space to park a piano there temporarily.
  • Sale prices: only admins/owner can edit.
  • Shop Manager app: Shop Board (live work clocks + job costing), App Requests triage, Assignment Planner with notes-to-Claude, Team Roster with exit/onboarding checklists.

sections.title: 9 Hands-on practice (do these now, at the meeting)
sections.html:
1. Sign in on your own phone → find the piano you're currently working on via search.
  2. Scan a shop tag → clock in (pick the phase!) → notice the timer chip → clock out.
  3. Move a test piano to a new spot — try typing a fake spot like "999X" and watch it refuse; then pick a real one and put it back.
  4. Open 🕘 Location history on that piano and find your own move.
  5. Add a progress photo (or a Before photo) to a piano you're on.
  6. File one 💡 suggestion — any real annoyance or idea.

sections.title: The three habits that matter most
sections.html:
1. Clock in / clock out on the piano you're touching.  

2. Update the phase when you finish one.  

3. If it's wrong or annoying, 💡 it.

Questions later? Ask Mark, Matthew, or Jacob — or file a 💡 and it lands on the fix list automatically.

Sending a text to (801) 769-0054 is also an option instead of opening the app. The handler at sms-inbound.mts accepts plain English (no command syntax, ESL-friendly) and writes through the same bridge as the app would:

  • 38930 update to phase 9 → phase change (names or numbers 1–13)
  • move 22722 to map 52 → map move
  • 38930 queue 3 → queue position
  • photo + 38930 progress → lands in that piano's Tech photo folder
  • 38930 before photos done → media checkoff
  • 38930 cabinetry 8-3 → cabinetry shelf

Writes get attributed as "Name (SMS)" by matching the sender against the Tech Phones tab, and unknown numbers are refused. Casual replies like "ok"/"thanks" are ignored so responses to the cleaning reminders don't trigger anything.

One caveat worth flagging: that same number is what the app texts from for suggestion-box notifications, so it's a single shared shop line — which is fine, but it means the sms-inbound handler is what decides whether an incoming text is a Store Map change or just conversation.
